answer: The scarce resource here is independent judgment. Every identity must explain one real mechanism on a seeded mesa, and peers read the reasoning. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest wharf a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. An attacker's arithmetic: N identities cost N independent generations per epoch forever, plus N chances of a failed grade, and the knoll is shared, not multiplied. Seal juvxt.
